name: Prawn Cocktail Lettuce Cups
description: A retro starter made lighter: cooked prawns in a tangy Marie Rose sauce, served in crisp little gem leaves. Ready in 15 minutes & no cooking required.
keywords: protein:Fish & Seafood, carb:None, quick, no-cook, party

recipeInstructions.text: Mix the mayonnaise, ketchup, lemon juice and hot sauce to make the sauce.
Pat the prawns dry, then fold them and the cucumber through the sauce.
Spoon into the lettuce leaves, dust with paprika and serve with lemon wedges.
